source_claim: An object is uniquely determined, up to isomorphism, by its representable functor.
lean_expression: Nonempty (yoneda.obj X ≅ yoneda.obj Y) ↔ Nonempty (X ≅ Y)
universe_profile: universe v u; C : Type u; Category.{v} C; yoneda.obj X : Cᵒᵖ ⟶ Type v
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory with mathlib Category; no additional axioms are introduced by the statement
computation_profile: Prop-valued existential equivalence; no computation is claimed
boundary_cases: X = Y is included without an extra hypothesis
empty and degenerate categories are included; the binders remain meaningful even when no X and Y can be supplied
uniqueness is categorical isomorphism, not object equality
the claim asserts existence through Nonempty and does not choose either isomorphism
